DARTLING.description: Barbed Dart adds 2 Poison if its hand has a pair.
DARTLING.name: Dartling

GEM_CULTIST.description: Restores the ally missing most HP when at least 5 HP is missing; otherwise attacks.
GEM_CULTIST.name: Gem Cultist

IRON_WARDEN.description: Alternates Fortify (self and group block) and Hammer.
IRON_WARDEN.name: Iron Warden

MIRROR_REGENT.description: Refraction → Shatter → Mending Glass. Below half HP: Refraction → Shatter. Resolve protects two slots after a stun skip.
MIRROR_REGENT.name: Mirror Regent

MIRROR_WISP.description: Reflection deals +4 if the target keeps its marked value.
MIRROR_WISP.name: Mirror Wisp

RED_SLIME.description: Stronger Strike, then Heal every turn.
RED_SLIME.name: Red Slime

RIFT_HOUND.description: Alternates Track and Pounce, targeting the hero with least block.
RIFT_HOUND.name: Rift Hound

RIFT_SOVEREIGN.description: High Tide → Low Tide → Eclipse. At 40% HP: High Tide and Low Tide each turn; safe total 19–23. Has Resolve.
RIFT_SOVEREIGN.name: Rift Sovereign

SLIME_KING.description: Slam → Fortify → Absorb. Resolve: after a stun skip, immune to external stun for two slots.
SLIME_KING.name: Slime King

ABANDONED_CACHE.description: Take 6 gold, or lose 8 HP for the displayed gem with +2 Carat. Requires more than 8 HP.
ABANDONED_CACHE.name: Abandoned Cache

ECHO_SHRINE.description: Take 5 gold, or replace one D6's faces with Paired, Odd, or Even faces.
ECHO_SHRINE.name: Echo Shrine

FIELD_MEDIC.description: Take 4 gold, or pay 8 gold to recover 20% maximum HP (rounded up).
FIELD_MEDIC.name: Field Medic

JEWEL_BROKER.description: Take 4 gold, or exchange one reserve gem for one of three displayed gems.
JEWEL_BROKER.name: Jewel Broker

ARDOR.description: Gain 2 block at the start of your turn when your final hand contains a pair.
ARDOR.name: Ardor

KAIT.description: Gain 3 block when a die finishes at least 4 higher than its initial value this turn.
KAIT.name: Kait

MAX.description: Once per encounter, reroll one die without spending your normal reroll.
MAX.name: Max

FIELD_DRESSING.description: Your first positive ordinary heal to an injured recipient each turn gains +2 healing.
FIELD_DRESSING.name: Field Dressing

FOCUSING_PRISM.description: Straight skills use +1 effective Clarity, up to 5.
FOCUSING_PRISM.name: Focusing Prism

LASTING_AEGIS.description: Carry up to 6 remaining block from a won battle into the next. Unequipping discards stored block.
LASTING_AEGIS.name: Lasting Aegis

MATCHBOX.description: Your Block gem grants +2 block once per actor turn.
MATCHBOX.name: Matchbox

MERCHANT_SEAL.description: Gain +3 gold from each normal or elite battle reward.
MERCHANT_SEAL.name: Merchant's Seal

MINERS_LANTERN.description: Gain 2 extra mining energy while alive.
MINERS_LANTERN.name: Miner's Lantern

STEADY_HAND.description: Strike deals +2 raw damage when no die was rerolled this turn.
STEADY_HAND.name: Steady Hand

TINKERS_BELT.description: Your first Workshop service each act is free. One service per visit.
TINKERS_BELT.name: Tinker's Belt

ARC_BURST.formula: Damage (highest value of chosen straight + C) × M(L) to up to K+1 distinct enemies. Extra targets do not add hits on a single boss.
ARC_BURST.name: Arc Burst

BLESSING.formula: Gain C gold, then self heal K × M(L).
BLESSING.name: Blessing

BLOCK.formula: Self block (highest pair value × K + C) × M(L).
BLOCK.name: Block

BULWARK.formula: Carat grants 10–300 block; self-stun at Cut 1–5: 3/2/2/1/0.
BULWARK.name: Bulwark

DRAINSTRIKE.formula: Damage H × K, then self heal C.
DRAINSTRIKE.name: Drain Strike

EVEN_TEMPO.formula: Self block (even result count × K + C) × M(L); damage C+K.
EVEN_TEMPO.name: Even Tempo

HEAL.formula: Self heal (lowest K dice + C) × M(L).
HEAL.name: Heal

HEAVYSTRIKE.formula: Damage (highest triple value × K + C) × M(L).
HEAVYSTRIKE.name: Heavy Strike

INTERPOSE.formula: Ally block (highest pair value + C + K−1) × M(L).
INTERPOSE.name: Interpose

LIFELINE.formula: Once per encounter revive a downed ally for C+3K HP; otherwise heal a living ally C+K. Revived allies act next turn.
LIFELINE.name: Lifeline
LIFELINE.trigger: Straight: 5 at L1–2; 4 at L3–4; 3 at L5

LUCKYSTRIKE.formula: Each 7: 7 × M(K) × J damage, then C × J gold. Three or more sevens: J=L+1 (7 at L5); otherwise J=1.
LUCKYSTRIKE.name: Lucky Strike

MULTISTRIKE.formula: K hits of C damage. Target stays fixed for this skill.
MULTISTRIKE.name: Multistrike
MULTISTRIKE.trigger: Straight: 5 at L1–2; 4 at L3–4; 3 at L5

SHIELDBASH.formula: Gain C block, then damage floor(current block × (K+1)/2). At L5, apply 1 stun.
SHIELDBASH.name: Shield Bash
SHIELDBASH.trigger: Three of one value and two of another

STUN.formula: Damage H+C, then 1 stun (2 at K5). K2–4 do not improve duration.
STUN.name: Stun

SUNDER.formula: Remove up to C+2K block; damage (highest pair value + C) × M(L).
SUNDER.name: Sunder

VENOM.formula: Damage floor((H+C)/2); apply K+ceil(C/4) Poison (12 stack cap).
VENOM.name: Venom

poison.description: End-slot damage bypasses block, including a stunned slot. Lose one stack after ticking.
poison.name: Poison

resolve.description: Bosses reject external stun for two slots after a stun skip.
resolve.name: Resolve

stun.description: Skip the next actor slot; ticks before the skill batch. Self-stun affects future slots.
stun.name: Stun
